layouts.name: Magny Cours
layouts.description: Complete closed main-course way 63951656. Separate Club circuit ways and pit lanes are excluded. Its approximate OSM length is 4.46 km; the FIA nominal length is 4.411 km, so geometry remains a draft.

layouts.name: Magny Cours Club
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Club configuration retains the northern kink, eastern tight turn and southern curved return; straight shortcuts excluded. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2547.7 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
